outcome: pain intensity (Numerical Pain Rating Scale - NPRS)
functional activities (Patient Specific Functional Scale - PSFS)
cohort: The study included 50 postpartum women who underwent lower segment cesarean section.
finding: Administration of TENS following LSCS significantly improved pain intensity and functional activities from postoperative day 1 to day 4.
mod_finding: The study found that TENS administration following LSCS significantly improved pain intensity and functional activities.
